title: Nike Training Introduces Prime, Train, Recover: A Connected System Built Around Athlete Progress
summary: Brought to life by advanced innovations like the new Nike Mind, Free and Pro, the connected system is changing how Nike Training serves athletes — whether they train as a sport or train for their sport, from the gym to the court, pitch and beyond.
body_markdown:
Nike Training is debuting a new connected system built around athlete progress: Prime, Train, Recover. The new system spans the full athlete journey, helping athletes get ready, get better and go again through athlete insights, science-backed solutions and Nike-only innovation designed around their physical and mental performance.


Brought to life by advanced innovations like the[new Nike Mind](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/the-expanded-nike-mind-platform-gives-athletes-more-choice-in-sensation) , Free and Pro, the connected system is changing how Nike Training serves athletes — whether they train as a sport or train for their sport, from the gym to the court, pitch and beyond.


“The workout is just one part of the journey. Progress looks different for every athlete, which means their training should too,” says Chloe Speed, VP/GM, Nike Training. “With Prime, Train, Recover, we’re creating one connected system that speaks directly to the needs of athletes, no matter how or why they train — helping them get ready, get better and go again.”


Athletes increasingly see training as more than just the workout. It’s about finding ways to progress or get better, which doesn’t begin or end with the first or last rep. Before training, they prepare with purpose. During training, they push to improve. After training, they recover to return stronger. The new Nike Training system is built in that image, delivering a complete performance ecosystem that turns Nike innovation into meaningful athlete impact.


- **Prime** helps athletes get ready through footwear and apparel solutions that support physical and mental preparation.
- **Train** helps athletes get better with head-to-toe innovation for Strength, Hybrid and Studio workouts.
- **Recover** helps athletes go again through innovative systems that support recovery.


The new system introduces two new Nike performance categories with Prime and Recover, and delivers new modality-led innovations across Train, with a sharp focus on Strength, Hybrid and Studio. It’s about building solutions that fit the way athletes train today, which starts by understanding and solving for the distinct demands of each modality and community.


**Prime: Helping Athletes Get Ready**


Prime is all about helping athletes prepare. One of the first expressions of that opportunity is **Nike Mind** . What started as a single footwear expression, the **Nike Mind 001** , is expanding into a more holistic innovation platform, exploring new ways to activate an athlete’s sensory awareness across science-backed footwear and apparel innovations. By studying perception, neuroscience and cognition, Nike is uncovering how the brain and body work together to unlock new innovations that support an athlete’s complete training journey.


As part of the expansion, four new Nike Mind footwear styles will debut in 2027, each designed to activate an athlete’s senses by amplifying underfoot sensation. While still featuring the iconic 22 foam nodes, a new secondary underfoot construction is being introduced to allow athletes to experience a range of underfoot sensations.


Designed for game-day preparation, the Nike Mind 001 and new **Nike Mind Sock** offer the most intense underfoot sensation, featuring the original construction of 22 individual moving nodes.


The new **Nike Mind Sneaker, Nike Mind Slip** and **Nike Mind Moc Flyknit** are engineered for all-day wear, featuring a new construction method that bridges the 22 foam nodes together, offering athletes a softer underfoot sensation.


**Train: Helping Athletes Get Better**


Across the Train silo, Nike is launching several new footwear and apparel innovations, including the next evolution of **Nike Free** and **Nike Pro** , which build on more than two decades of Nike innovation and complement existing performance innovations like the Metcon to better serve athletes through every step and rep.


Nike Free is returning to Training with a simple purpose: put the athlete’s foot to work.[The evolved platform](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/the-history-of-nike-free) , which debuts in 2027 with the new **Nike Free 3.0** and **Nike Free 5.0** , rethinks underfoot flexibility as a wave of contact, making the foot an active part of the workout by combining flexible ground feel with the traction, protection and support athletes need to move confidently in every direction.


Athletes train their entire body, but the foot is often overlooked. Nike Free changes that by leveraging new proprietary robotic siping, which carves through the midsole and outsole at various depths and angles informed by[Nike Sport Research Lab](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/lebron-james-innovation-center-nike-sport-research-lab) data, helping the shoe flex, articulate and grip in ways that promote natural foot motion.


Just as the new Nike Free builds on Nike’s leading natural-motion innovation, the evolved Nike Pro is built on the brand’s meticulous study of how athletes move, the forces they encounter, and the evolving demands of sport.


The result is a full suite of modality-based performance apparel that debuts in January 2027 with five new categories designed for the distinct demands of everyday training, weightlifting, hybrid racing and game day. These solutions comprise an evolved performance franchise, with close-to-body styles and recognizable design details that create a distinctive Nike Pro uniform for athletes who are ready to put in the work.


- **Nike Pro Powersuit** is Nike’s pinnacle expression of weight-training performance, including protective padding engineered to the exact specifications of weight training.
- **Nike Pro Strength** delivers elevated gym staples, featuring durable, high-stretch performance materials for men and zonal compression and a seamless look for women.
- **Nike Pro Hybrid** is designed for the highest levels of hybrid competition and training, featuring Nike Aero-FIT and Stealth technologies to help maximize airflow and sweat management.
- **Nike Pro Elite** includes ultimate game-day base layers with zoned compression and unmatched breathability for athletes across disciplines.
- **Nike Pro 365** offers everyday training essentials with anti-odor technology and breathable mesh.


**Recover: Helping Athletes Go Again**


Recover centers on creating accessible ways for athletes to rest and recover. By building recovery solutions into products athletes already wear, Nike is helping athletes fit recovery into their busy lives to maximize adaptation so they can come back stronger to perform or train again. One example is the newly released[Nike Air Zoom Hyperslide](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-and-hyperice-debut-the-nike-air-zoom-hyperslide-an-innovative-recovery-slide-for-all-athletes) , the latest innovation in[Nike’s partnership with Hyperice](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/hyperboot-by-nike-hyperice-official-images) , which combines low-profile Nike Air Zoom cushioning with targeted Hyperice heat and vibration to support everyday recovery.


The new system also draws on the insights of Nike’s partnerships with the world’s best athletes, including elite training athletes such as Hyrox world champions[Dylan Scott](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/how-dylan-scott-is-becoming-a-hyrox-champion) ,[Lauren Weeks](https://www.nike.com/my/training/nike-elite-training-division) and[Tim Wenisch](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-signs-three-time-hyrox-world-champion-tim-wenisch-to-the-nike-elite-training-division) ; roughly 3,000 global coaches and trainers; and gym partners such as[The Yard Gym](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-training-and-the-yard-gym-partner-to-shape-the-future-of-training) and[Temporary Humans](https://www.instagram.com/temporary.humans/?hl=en) . By combining those insights with Nike’s expertise in sport science, innovation and design, Nike Training is creating innovative solutions built on real athlete needs — serving more athletes and unlocking more human potential.


***NIKE, Inc. is offering a sneak peek of its new Nike Training system and innovations as part of its World of Athletes* event, which offers an exclusive first look into some of the footwear and apparel that will debut over the coming year. View the showcase***[here](https://about.nike.com/en/topics/inside-nike-strategy) ***.***


** If you have a body, you are an athlete.*
